units.name: Operations Management and Information Systems Academic Department (MOSI)
units.evidence: The official department page gives the full name and MOSI acronym, and explicitly includes purchasing, supply chain, quality management, urban logistics, maritime and air transport. Combined operations and information systems is in scope.

units.name: Research Centre in Supply Chain (CESIT)
units.evidence: The official Supply Chain (CESIT) page identifies a research centre in supply chain, with maritime, sustainable, digital, urban logistics and supply chain analytics research axes. The department page independently identifies its staff connection to CESIT.

decisions.reason: Official page confirms the full combined department name, organizational type and official MOSI acronym.

sources.note: University identity, full department name and acronym, operations/supply chain disciplines, teaching programs and CESIT connection.
Supply chain research centre identity, CESIT acronym and research axes.

limitations: Research paused at the owner's request after the two official pages were read. A broader academic and engineering inventory remains unchecked. Business Engineering is mentioned as a program on the department page, not verified as a separate department.
